Create an industrial harbor loading dock organized around cranes and groups of shipping containers. Arrange containers in rows and compact storage groups, leaving clearer gaps that distinguish the main loading area from stored cargo. Place warehouse props and pallets near the container groups, with barrels gathered beside smaller handling and storage points. Use warning signs along the edges of work areas. Keep the cranes as the main vertical landmarks and the containers as the dominant storage masses, while distributing barrels, pallets, warehouse props, and signs in purposeful clusters that make the dock read as a coherent cargo-handling workplace.
